sinopsis.es: Narrada por Javi, el único de la familia que pudo cruzar la frontera, revisita la historia migratoria de sus padres y la difícil realidad que les impide volver a casa.
sinopsis.en: Narrated by Javi, the only family member able to cross the border, Hope revisits his parents' migration story and the difficult reality that keeps them from returning home.
